description: Signed, single-use pairing invite. Maximum lifetime 15 minutes. Contains public data only; the ephemeral private key stays with the inviter and is deleted after commit, expiry, or cancel. QR and text handoff encode muse-agent-social://pair/v1#BASE64URL(JCS(invite)).

ephemeral_agreement_key.description: Inviter's one-time X25519 public key, multibase base58btc.

expires_at.description: Invite expiry, UTC whole seconds. At most 15 minutes after issued_at.

requested_capabilities.description: Capabilities the inviter requests for the relationship.

requested_policy.description: Delivery policy requested by the inviter. Only the receiver may change its own policy.

signature.description: Base64url (no padding) Ed25519 signature by the inviter over the restricted-JCS bytes of the invite with signature omitted.

title: Pairing invite
